messages:
maya: Heads-up: rotating encrypted_user_email column to new KMS key + backfill re-encrypt for auth.users tonight 01:00 UTC. Plan: add new column encrypted_user_email_v2 (nullable), backfill in partitioned chunks, then swap and drop old. Requesting deploybot pin to schema-v3.5.2 for the window and disable canary in eu-central-1. Estimated 2-3h. Ack?
diego: Ack. Any heavy locks expected?
maya: We'll use chunked updates with small transactions. There is a short exclusive lock during final column rename/swap (~2-5s). We'll run concurrency=2, chunk_size=5k.
olga: Abort criteria proposal: p99 DB latency >350ms for >10m OR KMS failures >1% for 5m OR replica_lag>60s. Also if re-encrypt job error rate >0.5%.
maya: Agree. Also add: if disk usage rises >90% on primaries -> abort.
deploybot: Pin request received. Pinning schema-v3.5.2 for release-group 'user-email-rotate' at 3201112345. Canary disabled in eu-central-1. Will emit progress every 10m and alert on configured thresholds.
opsbot: Drafted release note at release_notes/3201112345.md: "Rotate encrypted_user_email column to new KMS key. Backfill re-encrypt partitioned; brief rename lock when swapping columns. Abort criteria and rollback runbook in thread."
diego: Fallback if deploybot fails to pin: gate with feature flag 'user_email_rotate' -> false and stop jobs. @olga can you manual-unpin if needed?
olga: I can manual-unpin. I'll be on pager. :ok_hand: 
maya: Runbook and snippets:
```bash
# start backfill job (example)
./recrypt_backfill --table=auth.users --dst-col=encrypted_user_email_v2 \
  --src-col=encrypted_user_email --chunk-size=5000 --concurrency=2 --shard-range=all
# check progress
psql -c "SELECT run_id, status, processed_rows FROM recrypt_jobs WHERE run_id=%%RUN_ID%%;"
# swap columns (atomic)
BEGIN; ALTER TABLE auth.users RENAME COLUMN encrypted_user_email TO encrypted_user_email_old; ALTER TABLE auth.users RENAME COLUMN encrypted_user_email_v2 TO encrypted_user_email; COMMIT;
# emergency abort: flip feature flag and stop jobs
psql -c "UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='user_email_rotate';"
curl -X POST "https://internal.api/jobs/%%RUN_ID%%/stop" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
```
diego: Quick unpin CLI: `deployctl pin --release-group user-email-rotate --unpin`
opsbot: Added monitoring hooks for KMS error rates, DB p99, replica_lag, disk usage. Will page on thresholds.
maya: We'll run a 10-minute canary on a small shard (shard 42) at 01:05 UTC. If canary green, proceed sequentially.
olga: I'll watch and manual-unpin if abort criteria met. Please DM me immediately.
maya: final note: set feature flag 'user_email_rotate' true when starting, and false if abort. I'll kick the canary at 01:05.
deploybot: Canary run for shard 42 started. Pin confirmed for schema-v3.5.2. Posting progress updates to this thread.
oncall: Oncall acknowledged and monitoring dashboards open.
